SELECT t.*, CASE WHEN t.finished_count = 0 THEN 1 WHEN t.ongoing_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS can_start FROM ( SELECT e.id, e.course_id, e.student_id, e.create_time, c.name AS course_name, c.code AS course_code, c.duration_minutes, c.exam_enabled, u.real_name AS teacher_name, q.question_count, q.total_score,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_session s WHERE s.student_id = e.student_id AND s.course_id = e.course_id AND s.status = 0) AS ongoing_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_session s WHERE s.student_id = e.student_id AND s.course_id = e.course_id AND s.status <> 0) AS finished_count,
(SELECT MAX(s.score) FROM exam_session s WHERE s.student_id = e.student_id AND s.course_id = e.course_id AND s.status <> 0) AS last_score,
COALESCE( (SELECT s.status FROM exam_session s WHERE s.student_id = e.student_id AND s.course_id = e.course_id AND s.status <> 0 ORDER BY s.attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT s.status FROM exam_session s WHERE s.student_id = e.student_id AND s.course_id = e.course_id AND s.status = 0 ORDER BY s.attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1) ) AS exam_status
FROM course_enrollment e JOIN course c ON c.id = e.course_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.teacher_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS question_count, COALESCE(SUM(score), 0) AS total_score FROM question GROUP BY course_id ) q ON q.course_id = c.id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} ) t ORDER BY t.course_code ASC

SELECT e.id, e.course_id, e.student_id, e.create_time, s.real_name AS student_name, s.user_no AS student_no, s.department AS department, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_session es WHERE es.student_id = e.student_id AND es.course_id = e.course_id AND es.status <> 0) AS finished_count, (SELECT MAX(es.score) FROM exam_session es WHERE es.student_id = e.student_id AND es.course_id = e.course_id AND es.status <> 0) AS last_score FROM course_enrollment e JOIN sys_user s ON s.id = e.student_id WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY s.user_no ASC
